future_inputs: none; all arms use history only
long_readout: recurrence for state models; the same continuous lead-query decoder for direct arms, evaluated beyond trained leads

training.loss: equal-target masked MSE in shared training-IQR units plus the same multiscale increment loss for every arm

validation.selection: fixed chronological evenly spaced subset; target-macro normalized MSE
validation.mask_policy: actual observed labels only; same origins and per-target masks for every arm

execution.resume: explicit --resume preserves optimizer/scheduler/RNG and completed epoch; failed entries require an explicit same-config retry
execution.historical_test: after all 45 fits have completed, evaluate the same frozen matrix once; do not select or tune on it
execution.process_ownership: new private output directory; no interruption of unrelated jobs

research_scope.shared: architecture and training rules across three tasks; each task fits its own weights in this stage
research_scope.transfer: cross-task weight transfer is a subsequent registered comparison
research_scope.thermal: equivalent typed temperature/storage coordinates, not calibrated equipment energy inventories
research_scope.scr: nonnegative concentration source/removal surrogate; no claim of elemental conservation or measured reagent-to-side allocation
research_scope.thermal_connectivity: per-target local storage stars conditioned on shared history; no inter-target physical chain is asserted in this first stage
research_scope.mechanism_ablation: paired full mechanism versus no slow state, same data and training objective
research_scope.control: no closed-loop deployment or measured causal-response claim
